cp1Question: Does inputs.envelopeOutcome (site-model.ts EnvelopeOutcomeInput) carry a live-derived envelope that is not an atom, such that warmKind === 'buildable' is not proof of atom-backing?
cp1Answer: YES, on two independent grounds, so the printedBuildable union keys on the presence of an atom reference, never on warmKind alone. (1) STRUCTURAL: EnvelopeOutcomeInput's 'buildable' variant was declared as { kind: "buildable"; areaSqFt: number } with NO atom identity field at all -- nothing in the type ties a 'buildable' outcome to a persisted atom; a test seam or a future caller can construct one freely (confirmed: site-model.test.ts:246 and author.test.ts's pre-existing tests already did exactly this, passing a bare { kind: "buildable", areaSqFt } with no atom behind it). (2) PRODUCTION PATH: the ONLY real production populator is author.ts's resolveEnvelopeOutcome (site-plan/author.ts, 'Best-effort lookup of the parcel's own buildable-envelope atom outcome'), which DOES look up a real persisted BuildableEnvelopeAtomInstance from storage (listPropertyAtomsByParcelNodeId, entityType==='buildable-envelope') -- but it returns ONLY envelope.outcome, discarding the atom's own atomDid field in the process. So even the one real production call site could not construct a printedBuildable.atomRef without a code change, because the atom identity was being thrown away one layer up. CONCLUSION: extended EnvelopeOutcomeInput's 'buildable' member with an optional atomDid, changed resolveEnvelopeOutcome to thread envelope.atomDid through when outcome.kind==='buildable', and printedBuildable in site-model.ts checks warmKind==='buildable' AND a non-empty inputs.envelopeOutcome.atomDid -- both conditions, never kind alone.

designDecisions: printedBuildable: PrintedBuildable = { kind: "atom"; areaSqFt; atomRef } | { kind: "refused"; reason } added to SitePlanSummaryModel (site-model.ts), computed once in composeSitePlanModel, consumed by every render surface and by the narrative payload. buildablePdfLabel/buildableAreaSqFt/buildableAreaHonestNote are LEFT IN PLACE (marked @deprecated on buildablePdfLabel) rather than deleted: the LOCAL offset-ring figure still drives the drawn inset polygon per R-2, and buildableAreaSqFt is still consumed by the DXF/IFC emitters' own geometry (verified: those read setback.offsetRingLocal directly, never summary.buildableAreaSqFt, so no drawing behavior changes) and by buildable-display-vocab.ts's shared parity-locked mapper, which this lane does not touch (P-167's territory, moving into the atom-contract package this same wave).

The refused reason text is a NEW, single string ('pending — buildable-envelope atom not yet on file') computed once in site-model.ts, used everywhere printedBuildable.kind !== 'atom' UNLESS the shared vocab already produced an honest non-figure sentence (pending/absent/declined-consume), in which case that existing vocab string is reused verbatim instead of a second copy. This satisfies 'do not introduce a third copy of any display string' while still refusing every case (buildable-with-area, provisional) that the OLD code would have printed as a bare local number.

footprintContradictsAppraisal/improvementEvidence MOVED from pdf/feasibility.ts (presentation layer) to report-model.ts (composition layer), re-exported from pdf/feasibility.ts for backward compatibility (existing test manifest-is-load-bearing.test.ts imports them from the old path and needed no change). Necessary because narrative-section-client.ts (which builds the LLM payload, called from feasibility-author.ts BEFORE the PDF is rendered) cannot import from pdf/ without inverting report-model.ts's own documented layering rule ('the composition layer must not depend on the presentation layer').

New shared helper footprintContradictionConsequence(model) returns the ONE sentence both the facts-page consequence row and the narrative payload's footprint.consequence now use -- eliminates what would otherwise be a second hand-copy of that sentence.

New deterministic check findUnauthorizedBuildableFigures(narrative, printed, lotAreaSqFt) in narrative-generator.ts: scans sentences containing 'buildable' or 'envelope' for sq-ft or percent figures not matching printedBuildable (within ±1 unit of rounding); any offender refuses the whole narrative with a new reason 'printed-figure-mismatch', added to both NarrativeFailureReason and NarrativeFallbackReason. Scoped to buildable-labeled sentences (not every sq-ft mention in the document) so the model can still legitimately discuss lot area or living area in square feet without tripping the check -- verified both directions with tests (fires on a planted bad figure; does not fire on an unrelated lot-area/living-area mention).

emitPdfFeasibility gains an options.narrativeWithheldNote?: string, rendered as a new/extended 'Data quality' row, populated by feasibility-author.ts only when narrativeFallbackReason === 'printed-figure-mismatch' (every other fallback reason, e.g. no-api-key, is an operational state and gets no customer-facing note, unchanged from before this lane).

The prompt's false enforcement claim ('A sentence with no marker will be discarded.') is DELETED, not implemented -- implementing true per-sentence discarding was a materially larger, riskier change than the mission required, and the existing whole-narrative no-citations refusal plus the new figure check together already cover the actual defect class this rule existed to prevent.
